text.description_html:
Acorn WT2BD, Warwick Dummy Handle With Knob

Graded for residential doors of average weight and size, the Warwick Dummy Handleset features a s-shaped grip off set by lovely mounts that look as if they have been inspired by nature. It is perfect for restoration projects because of its old world design and material. The black iron finish is guaranteed not to rust. Dummy handlesets are most often used as a pull on the inactive side of double doors to match the existing trim.

Dummy Handleset: Trim for non-working doors. It does not latch and does not lock. Usually used as matching trim for the non-working side of double doors.

Also Available Matching:
Warwick Single Cylinder Handleset
Half Round Rough Black Iron Knob

Features of the Warwick Dummy Handleset:

  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Package Includes: inside knob, rose, outside handle, and all necessary mounting hardware.
  • Lifetime Finish Warranty

Specification for the Acorn WT2BD Warwick Handleset:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Exterior Blank Cylinder Rose Length: 2-7/8"
  • Exterior Blank Cylinder Rose Width: 2-1/8"
  • Exterior Handle Length: 10-3/4"
  • Exterior Handle Width: 2-3/4"
  • Interior Knob Diameter: 2"
  • Interior Rose Length: 2-1/2"
  • Interior Rose Width: 1-1/2"

Sold Individually
